answers.how: The ball moves about 80 px in 0.1333 s near 1.0 s, giving 600 px/s. The prior therefore gives 0.0556 cm/px. Its diameter is about 35 px.
Kettle height ≈128 px, multiplied by the ball-derived scale of 0.0556 cm/px.
White cylinder height ≈89 px, multiplied by the ball-derived scale of 0.0556 cm/px.
Green bottle height ≈230 px, multiplied by the ball-derived scale of 0.0556 cm/px.
Plastic bottle height ≈174 px, multiplied by the ball-derived scale of 0.0556 cm/px.
Plate height ≈77 px, multiplied by the ball-derived scale of 0.0556 cm/px.
The kettle and plate have a center-to-center separation of approximately 455 px; multiplying by 0.0556 cm/px gives the distance.
The cylinder and plastic bottle have a center-to-center separation of approximately 185 px; multiplying by 0.0556 cm/px gives the distance.
